# Artists & Illustrators

> A comprehensive resource for contemporary British artists featuring competitions, news, and community engagement through the British Art Prize and Artists of the Year initiative.

Artists & Illustrators is a leading platform for British visual artists and illustrators, published by The Chelsea Magazine Company Limited. The site provides news, resources, and opportunities for artists to showcase their work and compete for recognition through prestigious awards and exhibitions.

## Key Topics

- British Art Prize 2025
- Artists of the Year
- Art Competition
- Contemporary Art
- British Art
- Award Winners
- Painting & Sculpture
- Portfolio Plus Membership
- Online Submission
- Competition Entry
- Art News
- Mixed Media
- Artist Community
- 2025 Exhibition
- Shop Artwork

## Competitions & Awards

- [British Art Prize 2025 - Artists of the Year Competition](http://awards.artistsandillustrators.co.uk/): British Art Prize 2025 competition showcasing award-winning contemporary artists
- [How to enter - Artists of the Year Competition](https://awards.artistsandillustrators.co.uk/how-to-enter/): Guide for entering Artists of the Year Competition with submission requirements

- [Home - Artists & Illustrators](https://www.artistsandillustrators.co.uk/home/): Artists & Illustrators magazine homepage with art news and resources
